summary: SOPHiA GENETICS SA filed a Form 6-K reporting the results of its annual general meeting held on June 18, 2026. Shareholders voted on routine agenda items including approval of financial statements, discharge of directors, and re-election of board members and compensation committee. No special-situation transaction (merger, acquisition, tender, spin-off, etc.) was disclosed. This is a routine AGM outcome filing with no event requiring classification under special-situations categories.
